- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:3918-3921 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `_run_poller` harness runs `env = os.environ.copy()` and pops only `AUTOMATION_PATH_PLAN_AUTO_APPROVAL_ENABLED`, so the runner's real `GITHUB_RUN_ID` leaks into the poller. That run is missing from the mocked etag_304 blob (runs 1001/1002), so `_ensure_actions_runs_blob_has_self_run` (scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:18255-18304) forces a second live fetch.
  WHY: `test_actions_runs_cached_loader_uses_if_none_match_when_stale` fails in CI with `assert 2 == 1` at tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:26311 (CI shard 19 and orchestrate-poll, head 11ef7599). Locally it passes through `reason=no_run_id`. Sonnet says the same leak is the likely cause of the two gate-reported poller test failures (not confirmed). Fix: add `env.pop("GITHUB_RUN_ID", None)` next to line 3921, mirroring tests/test_orchestrator_concurrency_caps.py:479. All reviewers rated this BLOCKER.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:18293-18299 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: After the forced refetch, a live blob that still lacks the self run gets a plain `echo "ACTIONS_RUNS_SELF_CHECK result=refetched source=live ... self_run=absent"` with no `::warning::` prefix. The first-pass live branch (18276-18279) does emit `::warning::... result=absent_live`.
  WHY: The issue requires that a missing self-run in a live blob "logs a warning". Log analysis and annotations miss the most suspicious case. Severity disagreement: sonnet NIT (confidence 4), gemini MAJOR (confidence 5); the highest is used.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:18407-18418 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In `prime_phase_concurrency_snapshot`, the stderr forward (`cat "${actions_runs_fetch_err_file}" >&2`, line 18413) runs only in the success branch. In the else branch the ACTIONS_RUNS_SOURCE line is folded into `actions_runs_fetch_error` (trimmed to 200 characters, line 18416) and is never sent to stderr.
  WHY: On a loader failure the operator loses the structured `ACTIONS_RUNS_SOURCE source=...` diagnostic. Severity disagreement: gemini MAJOR (confidence 4), glm NIT (confidence 3); the highest is used. glm notes the path is reachable mainly through stubbed loaders. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rejected this finding as unreachable because `_load_actions_runs_cached` returns 0 on every path.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:18280-18289 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: A ttl_hit blob, or an etag_304 blob for the `status=in_progress` list, was written by an earlier process and can never contain the current `GITHUB_RUN_ID`. Every stall tick that starts from ttl_hit or etag_304 therefore makes the forced 3-read refetch.
  WHY: The TTL cache and ETag reuse save no requests on stall-recovery ticks (up to 3 REST reads per tick). This is within the issue's bound, but the API-contract comment at 18027-18033 and the changelog's "only when the self-run check fails" understate it. Rated NIT.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:22752-22819 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: `invoke_stall_judge` increments `judge_escalate_streak` on `escalate_human` (22752-22766) before the new hold at 20406-20409 suppresses the action when `STALL_ACTIVE_SET_UNVERIFIABLE=true`.
  WHY: Held, unverifiable ticks still count toward the `_judge_escalate_streak >= MAX_JUDGE_REPLAY` backstop (22769-22771), which forces escalate_human on a later tick. This partly undoes the hold. Rated NIT.
- tests/test_prepush_affected_tests.py:684-687 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The test expects six `CLAUDE_PARITY_PR_BASE_SHA` entries but finds one (only at `.github/workflows/ci.yml:3946`).
  WHY: The system-Python shard fails and the CI aggregate stays red. The reviewer says this is unrelated to the PR diff; sonnet, minimax and glm call it a base-branch failure.
- docs/INVENTORY.md:305-307 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The inventory omits `scripts/review_final_ci_failed.sh` and `scripts/review_final_ci_sweep.sh`, so `tests/inventory_parity.py:245-248` fails.
  WHY: The inventory-parity test exits nonzero and fails the release-and-log-analysis check. The reviewer says this is unrelated to the PR diff; sonnet, minimax and glm call it a base-branch failure.
